title: Ann Arbor Public Schools
description: The Justice Department (DOJ) threatened Ann Arbor Public Schools to withhold funding if they don’t comply with parental rights laws. The district told the DOJ that it amended its policy but the Education Department determined their revised language did not result in a substantial change and that the Board’s remarks “confirm the amendments were intended to preserve the prior policy’s effect.”
